title: Import block in auth.rs test module is inconsistent with rest of crate
description:
crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs test module (lines 314-322) constructs stoa_auth::config::UserCredential using an inline qualified path with no use declaration at the top of the test module. Other test modules in this crate (e.g. e2e_smoke.rs) group all imports at the top of the module with explicit use statements.

The make_store() helper would be more readable if it imported the type explicitly:
  use stoa_auth::config::UserCredential;  (or crate::config::UserCredential via the re-export)
and then constructed UserCredential { ... } without the full path inline.

This is a minor consistency issue: the rest of the crate's test modules declare imports at the top rather than inlining full qualified paths at the point of use. The aubi commit introduced this divergence.

File: crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs lines 304-323 (test module header and make_store helper).
